blocks.text: The alleged former driver of ex-House Speaker Lord Allan Velasco, who claimed to have delivered suitcases supposedly containing money to Vice President Sara Duterte, said Friday that he is seeking protection under the Department of Justice's (DOJ) Witness Protection Program (WPP).
